note: Shared Bengali vowel-model eligibility (lang/bengali/vowel_model.go embeds it; tools/bengali/vowels.py reads it). Spellings are NFC with format characters removed; nukta letters are decomposed. A word is eligible only if every unit is listed here. Clusters are max_cluster or fewer consonants joined by halant; members before a halant have no inherent slot. An inherent slot before an independent vowel makes the word ineligible.
